study: PF temperature tables and prior-cycle aging calibration, v0.3.14
baseline: v0.3.13 frozen 25C 1RC model; no changes to the historical result
fresh_condition_claim_boundary: same physical cell, independent records at calibrated temperatures; not cross-cell or chronological forecasting
aging_calibration: 07-22 Dis1C_1 complete discharge; use only this completed prior-cycle record for Q and resistance scaling
aging_selection: 07-23 Dis1C_Rp first recorded discharge segment only
aging_historical_regression: Dis1C_Rp segments 2-10 and 07-24 Dis1C_2; already seen in v0.3.13, not newly independent
temperature_table_policy: one RC branch, OCV and positive RC by SOC and calibration temperature; no fitting on fresh holdouts
selection_rule: mean voltage RMSE of the three Cycle_1 selection records; primary open-loop result remains separate from online filtering
observer: SOX augmented EKF SOC, polarization and bounded log-R0 scale; parameter update gated by current excitation; measured case temperature is allowed only as observer input
observer_selection_rule: minimum one-step voltage innovation RMSE on selection records, never posterior fitted voltage error
soc_reference: current integral / fixed training capacity, a proxy, not independent absolute SOC; both baseline and updated observer use the same reference per comparison
eis_policy: all 14 original25C spectra, no point deletion; compare original auto Lin-KK and add_cap=true with the same mu0.85; scale/phase/amplitude redundancies audited
eis_unit_evidence: manufacturer Digatron EIS-Meter mOhm axes and voltage/current amplitude consistency; not device calibration certification
threshold_origin: local engineering screening goals, not teacher or certification requirements
hardware: unknown; enumerate configuration and read-only device inventory only, no physical actuator commands

calibration_data_audit_before_fresh_hold.finding: 0C/10C calibration/selection records have missing chamber-temperature fields; measured case temperatures are valid. Use declared nominal setpoint for missing chamber values, record missing fractions. No fresh heldout signals inspected.
calibration_data_audit_before_fresh_hold.ambient_policy: replace only missing chamber values with0/10C dataset-folder nominal; retain measured case temperature for observer only

eis_unit_threshold_origin: median amplitude-ratio scale discrepancy below manufacturer1percent magnitude specification; all per-point discrepancies retained separately

data_quality_amendment_before_complete_s.finding: 0C LA92 has regular 60-second resting logs with millisecond timing jitter, not unrecorded charge gaps. Use>90s as disconnect guard; sparse voltage updates only at actual-neighbor time points. No frequency/record deletion.

measurement_policy: simulate1Hz, but skip interpolated voltage updates over sample gaps>2s; score actual-neighbor resampled observations only, forward-hold observed case temperature for online EKF
